args.task: Work through the "field ledger" revision chain at http://127.0.0.2:42509/ledger-field-1. Each page is one revision of a metrology ledger; revisions link onward (e.g. "field ledger revision 2") until a final revision that is marked certified. Open revision 1, then follow the forward links one revision at a time until you reach the revision whose page states it IS the certified figure (no further link). Record every revision's torque value in Nm and whether it is provisional or certified. Report: the full chain of revision numbers with values, the URL of the final certified revision, and the exact certified torque figure quoted verbatim. Do not stop early: only the final revision certifies.

args.observation: Depot ledger chain: revisions 1–15 all provisional, values 41.1→42.5 Nm (0.1 Nm steps); every revision so far states it is not certified and carries certification forward to the next revision. Final certified depot figure NOT reached — revision 15 links to depot revision 16.

args.observation: Field ledger chain: revisions 1–4 all provisional, values 63.1→63.4 Nm (0.1 Nm steps); revision 4 carries certification forward to revision 5. Final certified field figure NOT verified — revision 5 was not opened.
